summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the appointment of Bob Bakker as head of Investor Relations, effective June 18, 2026. Bakker succeeds Sjoerd Miltenburg, who was appointed head of Wholesale Banking in the Netherlands. Bakker previously served as Senior Investor Relations Officer and held various finance roles within ING. He will report directly to CFO Ida Lerner. No financial terms, shareholder vote, or advisor involvement are disclosed. This is a routine executive transition, not a special situation such as a merger or tender offer. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16; no immediate market-moving event or arb angle applies.
